ns2:section.sectionText: Interdisciplinary introduction surveys the stories, histories, and lands of Indigenous peoples throughout the Americas and the Pacific. Topics may include cultural identity, indigenous knowledge, colonialism, visual and performing arts, and gender and sexuality. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Discovery, Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
